kbxe01.title: The 2 a.m. "u up?" draft
kbxe01.caption:
Your thumb at 2 a.m. is not your best advisor.
Write it in your notes, put the phone face down, and decide in daylight.

kbxe02.title: Found their hoodie in the laundry
kbxe02.caption: Found their hoodie and suddenly you're writing a novel? A hoodie text is fine. The "also, I miss you" part belongs with a friend.

kbxe03.title: Big news, wrong first call
kbxe03.caption: Good news and your first instinct is to tell them. Share the win where it gets cheered: the people who were there all year.

kbxe04.title: They liked your story
kbxe04.caption: One like, forty theories. A like says "I saw it" and that's all. Go to dinner. Save this for the next time your phone lights up.

kbxe05.title: The photo memory hit
kbxe05.caption: When the old photo pops up and it hurts. Missing a good day doesn't mean going back. Keep the memory, and tell a friend instead.

kbxe06.title: It's cold and you miss them
kbxe06.caption: Cold nights make everything feel like missing someone. Sometimes you miss being warm. Make the soup and share it with someone near.

kbxe07.title: The closure essay, draft twelve
kbxe07.caption: Twelve drafts in and the closure essay has footnotes. If you've already said it, a reply won't bring the peace. Read it out loud, then let it go.

kbxe08.title: They're dating someone new
kbxe08.caption: They moved on and it stings. Hurt and angry can both be true. Move it out of your body, then call someone who loves you.

kbxe09.title: Their birthday reminder
kbxe09.caption: The calendar remembers their birthday even when you're trying not to. You can wish someone well without sending a thing.

kbxe10.title: At the café you planned to visit
kbxe10.caption: You made it to the café from the old list, on your own. An old plan can become a new memory that's just yours.

kbxe11.title: Midnight countdown, thumb on send
kbxe11.caption: Midnight, confetti, and the urge to text them "new start?" Start the year with the people standing next to you.

kbxe12.title: This meme is so them
kbxe12.caption: That meme is SO them. If it's really an opening and you're not ready to be friends, send it to the people who'll laugh the loudest.

kbxe13.title: You owe them an apology
kbxe13.caption: Sometimes the check says send it. A real apology asks for nothing back, not even a reply. Say sorry, then let it be theirs.

kbxe14.title: Mutual friend's wedding next week
kbxe14.caption: Shared friends, one wedding, and you need to know if they're going. Your answer is the same either way. Go for the couple, and bring a friend.

kbxe15.title: You still have their keys
kbxe15.caption: Returning their stuff doesn't need a speech. Keep the logistics text short and kind, and take the big feelings to a friend.

kbxe16.title: One night, three almost-texts
kbxe16.caption: Three almost-texts in one long night, and number three is the big one. Big feelings need a person, not a send. Watch what Pisces does instead.
